messages:
maria (Marketing): Need a focused benchmark narrative for next week's campaign. Core ask: an engineer-facing latency vs cost story that maps to decisions.
jon (Product): Keep it reproducible: publish configs, p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens for common seq lengths. Tiny "what this means" guide for product choices.
kevin (Eng): Two workloads: chat (~512 tokens) and completion (~128). HW: A100-80GB. Run q4_0 and fp16. Use continuous batching and KV cache.
amy (Content): Two headline directions: latency-first and cost-first. I'll draft both. Need charts: p95 vs throughput line + cost-per-1k grouped bars.
sam (Data): Started sweep. bench-bot: job 4901 running (1xA100, batch 1-32, kv-cache ON). I'll upload CSVs & PNGs when done.
maria (Marketing): We'll compare to a generic "typical managed endpoint" (no names). Phrase claims as "in our tests" and include methodology appendix.
jon (Product): Include a small mapping: <100ms p95 = interactive; 100-300ms = near-real-time; >300ms = async. Helps engineers interpret numbers.
kevin (Eng): Add reproducible YAML snippet for methodology in the blog. Also mention fallback path: quantized -> full-precision -> cross-region.
sam (Data): Results (prelim): chat p95 88ms @200tps, $0.28/1k tokens; completion p95 38ms @500tps, $0.13/1k. Uploading artifacts now.
amy (Content): I'll have draft narrative + 3 social blurbs by 3pm. Maria, want to A/B headlines in the campaign?
maria (Marketing): Yes. Assignments: sam -> data + artifacts, kevin -> methodology blurb, jon -> product CTA, amy -> copy + social. Review at 4pm PT.
bench-bot: job 4901 completed. Artifacts: results_4901.csv, p95_plot.png, cost_chart.png, metadata_4901.json.
maria (Marketing): Perfect. If review looks good we'll schedule blog + webinar sign-up next Tuesday.
amy (Content): On it :rocket:
